api/overview.title: API overview
api/overview.description: Document the public interface here. For each endpoint or function, list the purpose, parameters, response and errors.

architecture/adrs/ADR-0001-docusaurus-on.title: ADR-0001: Docusaurus on GitHub Pages for the docs
architecture/adrs/ADR-0001-docusaurus-on.description: The documentation site is built with Docusaurus and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

architecture/adrs/ADR-0002-justify-subdo.title: ADR-0002: Justify subdomains before creating them
architecture/adrs/ADR-0002-justify-subdo.description: A subdomain is created only if it needs a different runtime, security boundary, audience or external platform; otherwise content is delivered as a path.

architecture/adrs/ADR-0003-separate-publ.title: ADR-0003: Separate the public API from the webhook services
architecture/adrs/ADR-0003-separate-publ.description: The public portfolio API and the commercial webhook and workflow services are separate systems with separate repositories and hostnames.

architecture/adrs/index.title: Architecture decision records
architecture/adrs/index.description: The log of significant architecture decisions for rjmlaird.co.uk, with status, and the backlog of decisions still to be written down.

architecture/apis-integrations.title: APIs and integrations
architecture/apis-integrations.description: The services behind rjmlaird.co.uk, how they are separated, the conventions they follow and the third-party systems they connect to.

architecture/automation-workflows.title: Automation and workflows
architecture/automation-workflows.description: The scheduled jobs, queue consumers and CI workflows that run without manual intervention, and the principles for building new ones safely.

architecture/content-platform.title: Content platform architecture
architecture/content-platform.description: How content for rjmlaird.co.uk and docs.rjmlaird.co.uk is authored, validated and rendered, including the shared brand system and its known synchronisation gap.

architecture/domain-model.title: Domain and DNS model
architecture/domain-model.description: How rjmlaird.co.uk and its subdomains are resolved, which parts of the DNS setup are confirmed, and the rules for adding or retiring a subdomain.

architecture/environments.title: Environments and deployment model
architecture/environments.description: How code moves from a local machine to production for the docs site and the Cloudflare Workers services, with the verified CI/CD pipeline, branching rules and known gaps.

architecture/generated/subdomain-catalog.title: Generated public service catalogue
architecture/generated/subdomain-catalog.description: Public reference table of the services in the rjmlaird.co.uk estate, generated from the canonical catalogue.

architecture/media-assets-cdn.title: Media, assets and CDN strategy
architecture/media-assets-cdn.description: How assets move from controlled upload through asset management and approval to public CDN delivery, and how that separation is kept.

architecture/observability-status.title: Observability, status and incident response
architecture/observability-status.description: How the health of the ecosystem is monitored, how status is communicated and what to do when something breaks. Mostly proposed; little is confirmed.

architecture/overview.title: Architecture overview
architecture/overview.description: A map of the rjmlaird.co.uk ecosystem, showing what is live, what is being built and what is only planned, plus the principles that govern how the pieces fit together.

architecture/roadmap.title: Roadmap and decision log
architecture/roadmap.description: The sequence in which planned parts of the rjmlaird.co.uk ecosystem should be built or documented, the decisions still open and where decisions are recorded.

architecture/security-privacy-access.title: Security, privacy and access control
architecture/security-privacy-access.description: Who can reach what across rjmlaird.co.uk, how secrets and sessions are handled, and the privacy considerations that follow from the integrations in use.

architecture/standards.title: Naming conventions and standards
architecture/standards.description: Naming rules for hostnames, repositories, Workers and routes, plus the page template, front matter, status labels and callout conventions for architecture documentation.

architecture/subdomain-catalogue.title: Subdomain catalogue
architecture/subdomain-catalogue.description: How the canonical public service catalogue works, what each field means, when a subdomain is justified and how to change the catalogue.

architecture/subdomain-planning-inventor.title: Subdomain planning inventory
architecture/subdomain-planning-inventor.description: The original planning inventory of candidate subdomains with keep, merge, defer or avoid recommendations. Superseded for status by the canonical catalogue.

getting-started/quickstart.title: Quickstart
getting-started/quickstart.description: This page takes you from a fresh install to a working result in a few minutes.

guides/adding-a-service.title: Adding a service
guides/adding-a-service.description: The checklist for adding a new service or hostname to the rjmlaird.co.uk estate, from justification to documentation, in a single pull request.

guides/incident-response.title: Incident response
guides/incident-response.description: How to detect, contain, communicate and learn from an incident affecting the rjmlaird.co.uk estate, written for a single maintainer.

guides/publishing-data.title: Publishing data
guides/publishing-data.description: The review workflow for publishing a dataset through the public reference-data service, including licence, attribution and withdrawal.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to the documentation for my projects and tools. These docs are written for developers, integrators and collaborators who need to learn a tool and rely on it.

services/architecture/customer-journeys.title: Customer journeys
services/architecture/customer-journeys.description: How each service route moves from first contact to payment, which steps are manual, how return pages work and what is still to build.

services/architecture/overview.title: Services architecture
services/architecture/overview.description: How the booking, billing and webhook Workers fit together, where the trust boundaries sit, which Worker holds which secret and how delivery stays idempotent.

services/index.title: Services overview
services/index.description: What the rjmlaird-services system does, which Workers and hostnames it uses, how this section is organised and what is not built yet.

services/integrations/calcom.title: Cal.com
services/integrations/calcom.description: How Cal.com booking webhooks are configured and verified for the services system, including the values to enter, the assumptions made and known gaps.

services/integrations/hubspot.title: HubSpot
services/integrations/hubspot.description: How contacts are synchronised one way to HubSpot, the private app and properties required, retry behaviour and data minimisation rules.

services/integrations/stripe.title: Stripe
services/integrations/stripe.description: How Stripe Checkout and webhooks are set up for the services system, how signatures are verified, how duplicates are handled and how to recover missed events.

services/launch-checklist.title: Launch checklist
services/launch-checklist.description: Everything that must be configured, decided or built before the services system goes live, grouped by platform, with links to the detailed pages.

services/platform/api.title: api.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/api.description: The public, read-oriented portfolio and estate catalogue API, separate from private operational services.

services/platform/apps.title: apps.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/apps.description: The catalogue and presentation layer for maintained applications, which are classified once and linked by relationship.

services/platform/auth.title: auth.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/auth.description: The identity and access boundary for protected rjmlaird.co.uk services; Cloudflare Access is the primary edge control.

services/platform/booking.title: booking.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/booking.description: The booking integration boundary: service listing, booking intents and hand-off to the scheduling and payment providers.

services/platform/cdn.title: cdn.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/cdn.description: Public, read-only delivery of approved assets. It accepts no writes.

services/platform/dam.title: dam.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/dam.description: Restricted governance of media and document assets: metadata, rights, approval and what is published.

services/platform/data.title: data.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/data.description: A curated, attributed, read-only public reference-data API, distinct from the portfolio and estate catalogue API.

services/platform/dav.title: dav.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/dav.description: Private WebDAV attachment storage for Zotero. It is not a public file host.

services/platform/dev.title: dev.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/dev.description: A reserved hostname for developer-facing resources and release workflow. Nothing is deployed.

services/platform/docs.title: docs.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/docs.description: The public documentation site for the digital estate, built with Docusaurus and deployed to GitHub Pages.

services/platform/hooks.title: hooks.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/hooks.description: The verified inbound webhook gateway: it checks provider signatures and routes events to private processing.

services/platform/labs.title: labs.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/labs.description: Experimental and exploratory work, kept clearly separate from production apps and tools.

services/platform/master.title: master (control plane)
services/platform/master.description: A concept, not a deployed hostname: the canonical manifests that describe the estate.

services/platform/mcp.title: mcp.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/mcp.description: A restricted Model Context Protocol service that exposes approved tools to approved AI clients.

services/platform/overview.title: Platform services
services/platform/overview.description: The services in the rjmlaird.co.uk estate, grouped by role, with the boundaries that keep them separate.

services/platform/status.title: status.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/status.description: Curated public reporting of the health of public services, hosted independently of what it reports on.

services/platform/tools.title: tools.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/tools.description: The catalogue and presentation layer for reusable utilities, which are classified once and linked by relationship.

services/platform/upload.title: upload.rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/upload.description: Restricted, controlled ingestion of assets and content. It accepts writes and delivers nothing publicly.

services/platform/web.title: rjmlaird.co.uk
services/platform/web.description: The canonical public site for the rjmlaird.co.uk brand, writing, research, projects and contact routes.

services/reference/client-delivery.title: Client delivery Worker
services/reference/client-delivery.description: How the client-delivery consumer records workflows and hands new clients over, and how to add a real handover adapter.

services/reference/configuration.title: Configuration reference
services/reference/configuration.description: Every secret, variable and per-environment setting of the services Workers, grouped by Worker, with the rules for setting them.

services/reference/data-model.title: Data model
services/reference/data-model.description: The D1 tables used by the services system, their key constraints and status values, and what is deliberately never stored.

services/reference/events.title: Internal events
services/reference/events.description: The Zod-defined event envelope, the event types carried on the queues, money and CRM rules, and the versioning policy for backward compatibility.

services/reference/http-contracts.title: HTTP contracts
services/reference/http-contracts.description: The public HTTP endpoints of the booking, billing and webhook Workers, with request and response shapes, status codes and error format.

services/runbooks/secret-rotation.title: Secret rotation
services/runbooks/secret-rotation.description: Step-by-step rotation of the Stripe, Cal.com and HubSpot credentials used by the services Workers, including the zero-downtime Stripe procedure.

services/runbooks/webhook-failures.title: Webhook failures
services/runbooks/webhook-failures.description: How to find, diagnose and safely replay failed or missed webhook events in the services system, and when not to replay them.

tutorials/first-tutorial.title: Your first tutorial
tutorials/first-tutorial.description: A tutorial teaches by doing. State the goal, list what the reader needs, then give numbered steps that each produce a visible result.
